highlights: PRISMA 2020 review screened 502 records; 33 studies (2021–2024) were retained
PSO dominates SI algorithms, applied in 10 of 33 studies (30.3% frequency)
ACO is second most used, appearing in 3 of 33 included studies (9.1%)
PSO reduces swarm energy 15–34% vs. lawnmower in static environments (n=26)
Crop monitoring leads applications in 17 of 26 primary studies (65.4%)
